additional_prohibitions: Persons who are employed by any of the Source Agencies are not permitted to trade on the Contract.
Persons who hold any material, non-public information on the Underlying are not permitted to trade on the Contract.

important_info.markdown: **Important information:** Starting with markets settling on Monday, August 31, 2026, KXCOPPERD will settle using the Pyth Copper 24/7 index (Commodities.Index.CU/USD) as the source agency, replacing the front-month copper futures contract settlement price. Markets settling before August 31 will continue to settle under the front-month contract methodology.
